note: Keynote / interview style voice-over. `at` and `max` are seconds on the film timeline. `speaker` picks the voice role. Text uses Fish Audio S2 bracket cues for delivery.

zh.instruction: 成熟男声，男性主讲人，三十多岁，低沉、醇厚的男中音，语速从容，像在产品发布会舞台上讲一个打动人的故事，自信真诚，有停顿和起伏，不播音腔。普通话男声，安静的录音棚。
zh.reference_text: 我们一直在想一个问题：如果它不只是一个工具，而是一个真正的伙伴，会是什么样？

en.instruction: A male keynote presenter in his thirties with a warm, rich baritone. Calm, confident storytelling pace with natural pauses, sincere and inspiring, like telling the story behind a product on stage. Not a radio announcer. Clean studio recording.
en.reference_text: We kept asking ourselves one question. What if it was not just a tool, but a real teammate?

zh.instruction: 一位接受采访的年轻女性开发者，声音自然松弛、中等音高，带着笑意和一点小兴奋，像在纪录片采访里回忆做产品的故事，口语化、真诚、亲近，近距离采访麦克风。普通话。
zh.reference_text: 其实最开始我们就决定了，记忆不要藏起来，要让大家都能打开看看。

en.instruction: A young female software developer being interviewed for a documentary. Natural, relaxed, mid-pitched voice, smiling and a little excited, conversational and sincere, like recalling how the product came together. Close interview microphone.
en.reference_text: Honestly, from day one we decided memory should never be hidden. Anyone should be able to open it up.

zh.instruction: 一位虚拟电子歌姬风格的少女声线：音色明亮、偏高、清脆可爱，带一点合成器般的电子质感和轻微的机械感，吐字干净利落，语气活泼又亲切，像二次元虚拟偶像在给大家介绍小镇。普通话，安静的录音棚。
zh.reference_text: 欢迎来到小镇。这里的每个居民，都有自己的名字、性格和记忆，我带你慢慢逛一逛。

en.instruction: A virtual pop idol style voice inspired by vocal-synth singers: a bright, high-pitched, crisp and cute young female voice with a subtle synthesized, slightly robotic digital sheen, clean articulation, upbeat and friendly, like an anime virtual idol introducing her town. Clean studio recording.
en.reference_text: Welcome to town. Everyone who lives here has a name, a personality and a memory of their own. Let me show you around.

cues.speaker: presenter
cues.zh: [thoughtful] 我们一直在想：如果 AI 不只是一个对话框，而是一个有名字、有性格、有记忆的同事，会怎样？
cues.en: [thoughtful] We kept asking: what if an AI was not just a chat box, but a teammate with a name, a personality, and a memory?

cues.speaker: builder
cues.zh: [casual] 最开始我们就决定，记忆不要藏起来。它就是一个 Git 仓库，笔记、人格、代码，全是你打得开的文件。
cues.en: [casual] Early on, we decided memory should not be hidden. It is just a Git repo. Notes, persona, code, all files you can open.

cues.speaker: presenter
cues.zh: 每学到一点东西，它就留下一次提交。[curious] 想知道它为什么改变主意？点开 diff 就看到了。
cues.en: Every time it learns something, it leaves a commit. [curious] Want to know why it changed its mind? Just open the diff.

cues.speaker: builder
cues.zh: [light laugh] 连还没提交的改动，也算它的记忆。
cues.en: [light laugh] Even the stuff it has not committed yet counts.

cues.speaker: idol
cues.zh: [playful] 走错了也没关系，切个分支，重新来过！
cues.en: [playful] Took a wrong turn? Just branch off and try again!

cues.speaker: builder
cues.zh: 还能直接从一个 Git 仓库，长出一个新 bot。
cues.en: You can even grow a new bot straight from a repo.

cues.speaker: presenter
cues.zh: [storytelling] 然后我们想得更远一点：如果一个 bot 的灵魂，可以打包分享出去呢？
cues.en: [storytelling] Then we thought bigger. What if you could package the soul of a bot, and share it?

cues.speaker: builder
cues.zh: [excited] 它会飞到世界各地的工作台上，被一次又一次地 Import，在每个人手里，走出不同的人生。
cues.en: [excited] It lands on desks all over the world, imported again and again, living a different life in every pair of hands.

cues.speaker: presenter
cues.zh: 因为记忆就是一个 Git 仓库，这些世界线还能合并回来，收束成一个更丰富的她。[soft] 这部分，我们还在路上。
cues.en: And because memory is Git, those world lines can merge back into someone richer. [soft] That part, we are still building.

cues.speaker: idol
cues.zh: [cheerful] 当然啦，我们可不只待在小镇里！
cues.en: [cheerful] And of course, we do not just stay in town!

cues.speaker: builder
cues.zh: 连上飞书和 Slack，每个 bot 都用自己的身份出现在团队群里。哪些消息进来、交给谁，团队自己决定。
cues.en: Hook up Lark or Slack, and every bot shows up in your team chat as itself. Your team decides what comes in, and who takes it.

cues.speaker: presenter
cues.zh: 在 Group 里，人和 bot 坐在一起，艾特到谁，谁就接话。
cues.en: In a Group, people and bots share the table. Mention someone, they jump in.

cues.speaker: builder
cues.zh: [warm] 我最喜欢的一个瞬间：有人在飞书话题里艾特了 Nova，她读完前因后果，就在原话题里回了一份清清楚楚的总结。
cues.en: [warm] My favorite moment: someone tagged Nova in a Lark thread. She read the whole context, and answered right there with a clear summary.

cues.speaker: idol
cues.zh: [giggles] 忙起来的时候，我们的脸也会跟着变哦。
cues.en: [giggles] When we get busy, our faces change too!

cues.speaker: presenter
cues.zh: [playful] 后来我们发现，它们不只会工作。给一段 Persona，它们就是骑士、贤者和吟游诗人。
cues.en: [playful] Then we realized they do not just work. Give them a persona, and they are a knight, a sage, a bard.

cues.speaker: idol
cues.zh: [excited] 走吧，史莱姆洞窟就在前面！这段冒险，我会一直记得。
cues.en: [excited] Come on, the slime cave is right ahead! I will remember this one forever.

cues.speaker: builder
cues.zh: 每个 bot，最后都长成了独一无二的样子。
cues.en: And every bot ends up looking like nobody else.

cues.speaker: presenter
cues.zh: [thoughtful] 创建、分享、Import，然后一起生活。当成百上千个有记忆的 bot 住在一起，会长出什么样的故事？
cues.en: [thoughtful] Create, share, import, and live together. When hundreds of bots with memories share a town, what stories will grow?

cues.speaker: builder
cues.zh: [warm] 这就是我们想做的城：有人掌勺，有人打铁，有人读书，有人出海。每一个都带着自己的记忆，和你一起做事。
cues.en: [warm] That is the town we want to build. Some cook, some forge, some read, some sail. Each one carries its own memory, and works with you.

cues.speaker: presenter
cues.zh: Bot Harness。开源，基于 DeepSeek Harness。
cues.en: Bot Harness. Open source, built on DeepSeek Harness.
